highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and GPU correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Native interop now explicitly declares cdecl for LibraryImport calls. Collected updates after Preview 1 additionally correct reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection and work around affected Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer while preserving the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

bullets.lead: Safer path rasterization and glyph replay
bullets.detail: Corrects clipped convex-path buffer overflow, coverage-mask clamping and device-space path bounds. Direct-mask glyph replay gains validation, and Graphite readback from alpha textures to RGBx uses the correct destination stride.

bullets.lead: Reflected caps and text-atlas sampling corrected
bullets.detail: Later collected updates keep zero-length square-capped hairlines at device-space size under reflected transforms and round Ganesh atlas indices to avoid sampling the wrong texture.

Initializes render-pass pointers correctly. A later update adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport paths and avoiding selection of a different calling convention on Windows x86. Public APIs and native exports are unchanged.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with corrected path rasterization, glyph replay, GPU clipping and Graphite readback. LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 with native HarfBuzz still at 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching its DllImport calls. Package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and has no public managed API changes.
